description: CENTRAL CROSS-REFERENCE ORCHESTRATOR: receives track IDs and returns unified entities (metadata, artists, genres, audio features and lyrics where available). PREFER this tool to analyze any music collection.
name: enrich_tracks

description: Fetches lyrics in batch for a list of tracks (limited fan-out). Returns per track with the source marked.
name: lyrics_bulk

description: Queries Spotify Charts (global or by region) and returns the position of the given tracks.
name: chart_lookup

description: Downloads the image at a URL, resizes and compresses to JPEG ≤ 256KB and returns it in base64, ready for set_playlist_cover.
name: prepare_cover

description: Gathers data for the weekly report: top artists, top tracks, saved tracks and playlists. Returns the data so you can write the summary.
name: weekly_report

description: Searches images by concept (Openverse, commercial license). Returns results with thumbnail/url to use as playlist cover.
name: image_search

description: Undoes the last mutation made on a playlist (restores the previous snapshot). The restore is also confirmed by the user.
name: undo_last_mutation

description: Text search on the web via SearXNG. Use for similar artists by external opinion, trends, releases, shows, cultural context, or as a generic fallback when another tool fails.
name: web_search

description: Fetches the lyrics of a song (LRCLIB → Lyrics.ovh). Returns text and source. If not found, say you could not find them (never invent lyrics).
name: lyrics_lookup

description: Similar artists from external sources (Deezer + Last.fm when configured). Complements get_related_artists from Spotify.
name: similar_artists

description: Artist biography and info from Last.fm (bio text, tags/genres, similar artists). Returns source marked as 'lastfm'. Falls back to web_search when Last.fm is not configured/unavailable.
name: artist_info
